tagline: 理光便携相机，1991 年发布
description: 理光于1991年推出的便携相机。配备Ricoh Lens 35mm f/3.9, 3 elements in 3 groups。快门速度Electronic shutter, 1/125 ~ 1/600 sec.。感光度ISO 100 ~ 1000 (DX-code system)。Single-point active autofocusing system。

specs.镜头: Ricoh Lens 35mm f/3.9, 3 elements in 3 groups
specs.取景器: Reverse Galilean type 0.46X, field of view 83%
specs.闪光灯: G.N. 10 (ISO 100, m), auto-activating in dim light, no flash-off facility
specs.英文简介: The AF-66 is an autofocus point-and-shoot camera for 35mm film, introduced by Ricoh in 1991.
